The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of a strong, high bending resistance sandwich core is an effective way to reduce the impact deflection of sandwich structures subjected to impulsive loads, and this deflection reduction benefit will be even more pronounced if the impact face is kept further from the impulsive load source than the solid plate equivalent.

a sandwich panel with a strong core and thin face sheets is a better design than a solid plate of the same material and mass per area when the impact loading consists of a radially expanding impulsive front of granular matter.
